title: Platform settings
description: Settings for the platform AI agent, its tools and the permission system. This file is generated — do not edit it by hand, change platform-config/src/schema.ts instead.

maxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages sent to the LLM. Older ones are dropped (compacted first if compaction is enabled).

toolResultLimit.description: Maximum length (characters) of a single tool result stored in history, so long `read`/`bash` output does not swamp the context.

enabled.description: Automatically compact history when the context fills up. If disabled, a long conversation stops fitting in the context window.

reserveTokens.description: Part of the context window reserved for the summary prompt and the response. Compaction starts once the context exceeds (window - reserve).

keptTokens.description: How much of the most recent context is kept verbatim after compaction. A larger value keeps recent history more precise but makes compaction less effective.

model.description: Model used for compaction, as `provider/model`. When `null` the main chat model is used (summary quality matters, hence the default).

enabled.description: Tools given to the agent. A tool removed from the list is invisible — the agent does not know it exists.

bashTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum run time for a single `bash` command. Waiting forever would freeze the web session.

resultLimit.description: Maximum length (characters) of a tool result sent to the UI. The limit for what is stored in history is configured separately.

mode.description: Initial permission mode for a new session. `confirm` asks about every dangerous action; `auto` lets the classifier decide.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for an answer to a permission request. On timeout the request is DENIED, so the agent does not hang forever.

classifierModel.description: Model for the auto-mode classifier, as `provider/model`. When `null` it is chosen automatically FROM THE CHAT'S OWN PROVIDER — that one is known to be reachable and paid for, whereas the cheapest model overall may sit on a billing channel with no credit on it.

consecutiveBlockLimit.description: Auto mode turns off after the classifier blocks this many actions in a row — the agent may be going beyond what was asked.

totalBlockLimit.description: Auto mode turns off after this many blocks in total during a session.

extraDenyList.description: Additional forbidden command names. They are ADDED to the built-in hard block list, never replace it — the security boundary cannot be lowered.

workDir.description: Root directory the agent tools work in. When `null`, `~/.barpo/work/` is used.

idleMinutes.description: In-memory resources of a session idle for this long (permission state, mode) are cleaned up. The conversation history stays in the database.

connectTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum wait for the MCP server handshake. If the server does not respond the session continues — only that server is unavailable.

callTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum wait for a single MCP tool call.

maxFileMb.description: Maximum size (MB) of a single file attached to a chat.

maxCount.description: Maximum number of files attached to a single message.
